title: Picking, never bowing, and no formal lessons
summary: He only picked the bass, never mastered the bow, and Tasso's attempts to teach him music failed.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did you start bowing on it or picking?
No, just the picking, that's all. I never was accomplished with the bow at all.
Did you ever take any formal lessons?
No, Mr. Tasso tried to teach me but I never could get my heart to learn the music, you know. I just wanted to play music and play jazz and that was about it, you know.
